## Checklist

### Language
- [ ] All text, comments, and documentation are written in British English

### Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)

- [ ] Keyboard navigability verified
- [ ] Sufficient colour contrast checked
- [ ] Meaningful `alt` text added to all images
